canonical.title: A Moutfort weekend around Ma Langue Sourit

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Ma Langue Sourit
siblings.summary: No hotels exist within walking distance of MLS; the only true walking options are short-term apartment rentals in Moutfort or Oetrange village.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Ma Langue Sourit
siblings.summary: Ten distinctive hotels — boutique, heritage, thermal, castle — all reachable by a short taxi from Cyril Molard's two-star Moutfort kitchen.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Ma Langue Sourit
siblings.summary: Luxembourg City UNESCO Old Town sits 12 minutes from Moutfort. Add Moselle wine cellars, Mullerthal hikes, Trier's Roman monuments, the Schengen tripoint, plus Mondorf spa and Bettembourg.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Ma Langue Sourit
siblings.summary: Luxembourg's 2026 tech-event calendar from Moutfort: hack.lu, Voxxed Days, Nexus, Luxembourg Internet Days — every major venue is well inside the 30 km radius.

sources.title: Ma Langue Sourit — Contact
sources.claim: 1 rue de Remich, L-5331 Moutfort; Tue–Sat midday–4pm and 7pm–midnight; no on-site lodging.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — Ma Langue Sourit
sources.claim: Two Michelin stars under Cyril Molard.

sources.title: Bergfex — Éitermillen ↔ Moutfort hike
sources.claim: MLS sits at the Éitermillen mill, 1.4 km from Moutfort village, along an unlit country lane (141 m elevation gain).

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotels in Moutfort
sources.claim: Zero hotels listed in Moutfort village.

sources.title: Airbnb — Moutfort stays
sources.claim: Apartment rentals from $20/night, average ~$178/night; restaurants in walking distance per guest reviews.

sources.title: Airbnb — Oetrange stays
sources.claim: Next-village fallback for walking-distance lodging, 4.9/5 average.

sources.title: Mercure Luxembourg Kikuoka Golf & Spa
sources.claim: 4★ hotel in Canach, ~4 km from MLS, with 400 m² spa, golf, free parking.

sources.title: Hotel Le Place d'Armes
sources.claim: 30-room Relais & Châteaux boutique on Place d'Armes — Luxembourg's only Michelin-Key hotel.

sources.title: MICHELIN Keys — Le Place d'Armes
sources.claim: First Michelin Key awarded in Luxembourg.

sources.title: Les Jardins d'Anaïs
sources.claim: Seven-room boutique in Clausen with a Michelin-starred restaurant; rooms themed (Provence, savannah, library).

sources.title: La Pipistrelle
sources.claim: 4-suite B&B in the UNESCO-listed Grund behind an 18th-c. façade.

sources.title: Hotel Parc Beaux-Arts
sources.claim: 11-suite property next to the Palais Grand-Ducal with beamed ceilings, Murano lighting, medieval stonework.

sources.title: Mondorf Parc Hôtel
sources.claim: 4★ superior thermal-spa hotel in a 45-ha park; 108 rooms; thermal pool + 12 saunas.

sources.title: Mondorf Domaine Thermal
sources.claim: Luxembourg's only thermal spa — 36 °C mineral pool, 11 saunas, 3 hammams.

sources.title: Domaine la Forêt
sources.claim: 4★ Remich hotel between vineyards and woodland; 16 rooms; 700 m² spa; MICHELIN Guide restaurant.

sources.title: Hotel de l'Ecluse Superior
sources.claim: Design hotel on the Moselle in Stadtbredimus; every room has a balcony onto vineyards or river.

sources.title: Château de Schengen
sources.claim: Heritage hotel in Schengen village, reopened June 2024 after full renovation.

sources.title: Bock Casemates
sources.claim: 23 km of underground galleries; Tripadvisor 2026 Travellers' Choice; €8 adult.

sources.title: Chemin de la Corniche
sources.claim: 'The most beautiful balcony of Europe' — 17th-c. Spanish/French ramparts over the Alzette valley.

sources.title: Neumünster Abbey
sources.claim: 1688 Benedictine abbey in the Grund, now a cultural centre. Saint-Esprit/Grund lift runs to 02:00 (04:00 Fri/Sat).

sources.title: MS Princesse Marie-Astrid timetable
sources.claim: Easter-to-September Moselle cruises: Grevenmacher–Wormeldange–Stadtbredimus–Remich–Schengen and Trier.

sources.title: Caves St Martin — Remich
sources.claim: 1-hour cellar tour with tasting, €9/pp; 48 h advance booking.

sources.title: Mullerthal Trail — Route 2
sources.claim: 39.7 km loop with 387 m elevation; Schéissendëmpel, Wollefsschlucht, Kuelscheier.

sources.title: Schiessentümpel waterfall
sources.claim: Three-stream cascade with an 1879 sandstone bridge — the symbol of Luxembourg's Little Switzerland.

sources.title: Porta Nigra — Trier
sources.claim: 2nd-c. Roman fortified gate, UNESCO World Heritage; Trier's signature monument.

sources.title: UNESCO — Trier's Roman monuments
sources.claim: Roman monuments + Cathedral of St Peter + Liebfrauenkirche inscribed jointly.

sources.title: Schengen — visitor info
sources.claim: Schengen European Museum at the Luxembourg–France–Germany triangle; 10:00–18:00.

sources.title: Beaufort Castle
sources.claim: Medieval ruins + 17th-c. residence; €8 adult; Cassero blackcurrant tasting included.

sources.title: Parc Merveilleux — Bettembourg
sources.claim: Family park; €15 adult, €11 child (3–14); €1.50 per attraction token.

sources.title: Luxembourg — free public transport
sources.claim: All public transport free since 29 Feb 2020 for residents and tourists (2nd class).

sources.title: Voxxed Days Luxembourg 2026
sources.claim: 18–19 June 2026 at Casino 2000 Mondorf; 9th edition; ~500 attendees; 70+ talks across 9 tracks.

sources.title: hack.lu 2026
sources.claim: 20th-edition security conference, 20–23 October 2026 at Parc Hotel Alvisse.

sources.title: Nexus Luxembourg 2026
sources.claim: 10–11 June 2026 at LuxExpo The Box, Kirchberg; 10 000+ attendees; 150+ speakers.

sources.title: Luxembourg Internet Days 2026
sources.claim: 17–18 November 2026 at the Chamber of Commerce; free admission; 1 300+ professionals.

sources.title: BSides Luxembourg 2026
sources.claim: 6–8 May 2026 in Belval; community-driven cybersecurity event.

sources.title: Webtaxi — fares
sources.claim: Luxembourg taxi fares deregulated; ~€3/km plus pickup fee.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Luxembourg ↔ Moutfort
sources.claim: Luxembourg City to Moutfort: 12.5 km / ~12 min by taxi.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Ma Langue Sourit reviews
sources.claim: MLS has on-site validated parking; staff routinely call taxis for late-departing diners.
